hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad launchpad that collects platform swap fees on every trade, splitting them between the token creator and treasury. A creator-configured fraction of the creator's fee share is earmarked for automatic buyback-and-burn of the launched token. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the blocks immediately after launch and a time-limited surcharge on sells from the original deployer address.
